```sh
kafka cluster unregister-controller
```

Unregister a controller that was removed from the KRaft quorum for good (Kafka 4.4+)

Shared options and defaults: [connection profiles, JSON output, logging and help](../../../global-options/).

## Defaults

Unregisters the explicitly named controller; it does not remove it from the metadata quorum.

## Before you run

Removes the controller registration. Remove the controller from the quorum first with cluster raft-voter remove; the active controller cannot be unregistered, and the cluster must run metadata.version 4.4-IV2 or later.

## Flags

| Flag                       | Description                                              |
| -------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--brokers <string>`       | comma-separated broker list, e.g. localhost:9092         |
| `--controller-id <number>` | id of the controller to unregister                       |
| `--yes`                    | confirm the unregistration without an interactive prompt |

## Examples

```sh
kafka cluster unregister-controller --controller-id 3001 --brokers localhost:9092 --yes
```

## Output

Illustrative, abbreviated output. Empty arrays show the result envelope; actual entries, identifiers, optional fields and broker errors depend on the request and cluster.

With `--json`:

```json
{
  "controllerId": 3001,
  "ok": true
}
```

Declared exit codes: `0`, `1`, `2`, `5`. See the exit-code reference for meanings.
